Name: Hermas
Summary: Hermas was a Christian in Rome greeted by Paul alongside Asyncritus, Phlegon, Patrobas, and Hermes.
KeyStory: Hermas was a Christian in Rome greeted by Paul alongside Asyncritus, Phlegon, Patrobas, and Hermes.
LifeLesson: Being named among the saints is itself a testimony of belonging.
